notes.title: Hotfix v2.1
notes.content:
Just a quick update to squash some of the bugs that appeared in the new version 2.0. 

Thanks to everyone who reported bugs! I know there are more out there, so keep reporting when you find them. I appreciate you.

notes.title: The Radiants v2.0 is HERE!
notes.content:
What’s New


CG Gallery

Relive your favorite moments! You can now view and review every CG scene you have unlocked so far.
How to Access: Navigate to the title menu and select "Gallery". All unlocked scenes will viewable here.


Extended Epilogues

Feature Description: Fall deeper into the story with brand-new extended epilogues! Each ending now features an additional scene with your chosen love interest, providing a glimpse into your future life together.

Unique dialogue and scenarios tailored to each romance option. Discover new secrets, milestones, and heartfelt moments.


New Romance Route: Professor Balin

Get cozy with the mysterious and handsome Siren, Professor Balin! A reserved yet charming intellectual with a passion for ancient artifacts and forbidden lore.



Quality of Life Updates

Minor UI enhancements to improve navigation in the in-game menu.

Fixed typos and minor errors in several scenes. (Please keep reporting these, one day, I dream of being bug free!)


Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We hope you enjoy these new features and can’t wait to hear about your experiences with the latest update. Happy gaming!

notes.title: The Radiants v1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
I have released a quick update to take care of some of the major issues we've found on release day. I will continue to work on squashing any additional bugs in the coming days.



The Radiants v1.1 Patch Notes:


Fixed

- Certain choices not registering in later events (Arien Route)
- Ending getting stuck on blank screen
- Certain graphical elements not appearing on screen (but appearing in log)
- Various graphical glitches
- Not being able to move past week 10 in some routes
- Certain choices always being greyed out


Still Testing

-  Classes not giving the correct stats

I believe this has been fixed, but want to wait to see if users are still experiencing this bug before declaring it done.


- Some text showing multiple times when using Enter/Space

I have fixed this issue in certain scenes that were reported. However, if you experience this bug in your game, please note the Week/Day it occurs so that I can find the issue for the next patch. Thanks!

- Saving on the map screen causes chaos

This is a known issue that is still being worked on. In the meantime, please avoid saving while on the map screen.

notes.title: Kickstarter is Coming!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/cdtbEri.jpg

Kickstarter Prelaunch!
Exciting news! We are launching our official Kickstarter campaign for The Radiants in mid-April. We've got some pretty cool rewards set up, including a Lorebook that contains details and art about the world of The Radiants and a game walkthrough/guide. 

You'll also have the option to become an Alpha Tester - getting updates throughout the game's development. We'll take your feedback as the game progresses!

On top of the base rewards, we also have some pretty exciting stretch goals, including extra romance routes for those that just can't get enough. 

Follow our prelaunch page to be notified when the campaign goes live!
